text:
anya: Quick publish of the lumen-7b onboarding run — I kicked off the usual perf harness on dedicated-dc1 (2x A100s), seq=1024, batch=4, Q4_K_M quant, kv-cache enabled. Summary: throughput ~247 tok/s, p95 ~1.2s, p99 spiked to 2.4s on tail. Full artifact linked below. :mag:
mike: Can you paste the exact runner command and config? want to repro the spike locally.
anya: Sure — ran:
```
./run_bench --model lumen-7b --device gpus --replicas 2 --bs 4 --seq 1024 --quant q4_k_m --kv_cache yes --warmup 100 --iters 500
```
ci-bot: Benchmark artifact uploaded: https://ci.internal/bench/artifacts/1841236789/lumen7b-onboard.json
olivia: Looking at the artifact graph — the p99 jumps correlate with GC spikes on the host (look at cpu-steal). Also saw a sudden increase in memcpy time in timeline. :eyes:
sanjay: Did we change kernel selection recently? last week's baseline for a similar model was ~280 tok/s at seq=1024 on same infra.
anya: We upgraded to the new fused-attn kernel in runtime v0.9.2 which should improve long-seq perf, but this model appears to regress. I also toggled microbatching threshold to 16 for this run.
kaushik: Can you try a quick re-run with microbatch threshold lowered and without the fused-attn opt (force legacy kernel)? if perf improves that's a kernel regression.
anya: Will run a back-to-back: (1) force_legacy_kernel + mb_th=8, (2) rollback fused-attn flag + keep mb=16. Kicking first now.
mike: Also please include a run with quantization toggled to q8_0 to check if quant path has issues.
anya: ack. scheduling three short runs, each 10 min smoke. I'll post artifacts when done.
ci-bot: Run #1 (legacy kernel, mb=8) done: https://ci.internal/bench/artifacts/1841236789/lumen7b-legacy.json
anya: quick diff — legacy run throughput 281 tok/s, p99 ~1.05s. That matches baseline. So seems regression tied to fused-attn path.
olivia: Nice repro. Can you capture nvprof on the fused-attn run? want to see kernel launch/serialization.
anya: Starting an nvprof trace now for the fused-attn case. Will attach when finished.
sanjay: Filing an issue for runtime/fused-attn with traces + artifact. tagging runtime-owners. @kaushik @mike please triage and decide rollback or patch.
kaushik: On it. If fused-attn causes tail lat regression across models we should hot-fix; prioritizing.
mike: One last note — document shows slightly higher memory alloc churn during fused run; might be allocator fragmentation. I'll try a mempool tweak in a follow-up run.
anya: Thanks team — nvprof and full metrics uploaded: https://ci.internal/bench/artifacts/1841236789/lumen7b-fused-trace.zip :thumbsup: Will leave the fused run flagged in the onboarding dashboard as 'regressed' until runtime fix.
ci-bot: Dashboard tile updated: https://perf.internal/dashboards/onboarding/lumen-7b — status: REGRESSED (investigating)
olivia: Great signal work, short repro path. We can do a canary rollback on runtime v0.9.1 if needed.
anya: I'll add the exact repro steps and links to the issue. Thanks all.
